notes: PROC FORMAT slice from SisuFormaatit.sas reproducing the model's classification formats: the tuhat thousand-separator PICTURE plus the desmod (income decile), ikavu (age band), soss (socioeconomic status), and koulas (education level) VALUE formats, with their original value ranges and selites (Finnish a-/o-umlaut transliterated to ASCII; NOTSORTED MULTILABEL kept). A small example person table is then printed with PROC PRINT applying each format. Format definitions and ranges unchanged.
